notes.subject: ol man
notes.rationale: Hibru i no tok long ol man — bel bilong ol man i painim, Tok Pisin i nidim olgeta ol man long klikim tok.

notes.subject: bel bilong ol man
notes.rationale: לֵב i tok long bel bilong tingting na laik — Tok Pisin 'bel' i holim mining, tasol 'hat' o 'lewa' i no stret.

notes.subject: התהללו / הלל
notes.rationale: Em i tok bilong 'haleluya' — pes i stat long hallel-form, na Tok Pisin i no inap holim nois bilong en.

translation: Sekim nem long nem holi bilong en; bel bilong ol man i painim Yahwe i save amamas.
